text:
Kai: Quick note from onboarding a customer using Lambda + our Node SDK: sometimes logs flip to DEBUG for the first 10s and request ids are missing on retries. Repro is intermittent.

Renee: Likely init ordering with OTel auto-instrumentation. Lambda cold start wiring can run instrumentations after user bootstrap depending on handler wrapping.

Omar: Example snippet from the run:
INFO  [req=tz1] handler received event
DEBUG [req=] http request headers: { authorization: 'Bearer sk-test-zzz' }
INFO  [req=] handler response

Kai: We also saw the redactor failing to mask when the header value is a Buffer/Uint8Array (OTel sometimes serializes that way).

Renee: Short term: add a small startup warning in sampleapp when OTEL_* env vars are set and REDWOOD_LOG_LEVEL not explicitly set. Recommend calling telemetry.register() before logger.init() or call logger.reconfigure() after instrumentation.

Omar: Long term: change logger to lazy-evaluate level on first log, add logger.reconfigure() hook, and attach req-id to the raw http.IncomingMessage prototype to survive wrappers. Redactor: coerce buffers to strings and deep-scan nested maps for header-like keys.

telemetry-bot: Created ticket DX-7550: "lambda init race: otel can override log level and drop req-id; redactor misses buffer headers". Assigned Omar, priority P2.

Kai: I'll add the onboarding blurb and a tiny stress script to the sampleapp repo and link DX-7550.
